transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because my head just doesn't really stay on task anymore. It's... like, I'll be doing inventory at work, or trying to study for my supervisor certification, and I just keep reading the same line over and over. Or I'll walk all the way to the supply closet and completely forget what I even went in there for. It's just getting really frustrating.
About how long have you been experiencing these difficulties with staying focused?

It's been going on for about three years now. It pretty much started right around the time the contractor changed our schedules. They switched us to rotating evening and overnight shifts at the larger properties, and... yeah, it's been happening ever since then.
How has your sleep been affected since your work schedule changed to rotating shifts?

Honestly, my sleep has been messed up for a long time now. Like, after an overnight shift, I'll just lie there in bed... I'm exhausted, but wired at the same time. And even when I do manage to sleep a decent number of hours, I still wake up feeling like I barely rested at all.
Do your sleep problems and fatigue get better when you have several consecutive days off or take vacation from work?

I'm not really sure about vacations, to be honest. I haven't taken a real one in a long time. But even when I do get a couple of consecutive days off... no, it doesn't really get better. I just spend those days trying to catch up on rest, but I still feel just as exhausted when I have to go back in to work.
Are you currently still working rotating evening and overnight shifts?
Yeah, I am. I'm still on the same rotation. It's just part of the job at this point, so I just... keep doing it.
